claims: "7" is a 1992 song by Prince and the New Power Generation from the Love Symbol Album.

The song "7" peaked at number 7 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song "7" was the third single from the Love Symbol Album.
The song "7" features a middle-eastern influenced mid-tempo groove.
The song "7" has an acoustic feel.
The song "7" has an opera-like chorus.
The song "7" was recorded between September 1991 and March 1992.
The song "7" was recorded at Paisley Park Studios.
